privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.dataBody: We store only account data in Firebase Authentication: your email address, nickname and account ID. Email is used only to log in, verify the account and reset the password. Other players cannot see it.
privacy.infraBody: The app runs on Cloudflare infrastructure (site hosting and the game server). Cloudflare processes the network traffic needed to run the service.
privacy.gameBody: We do not store results, rankings or trade history. Game data exists only in room memory and in your browser.
privacy.browserBody: In your browser we store only the language you chose. Firebase keeps a login session there so you stay logged in.
privacy.deleteBody: You can delete your account in the main menu, in the Account section. It asks for your password again and removes the account from Firebase.
